desktop.title: Same MCP version. Different tool description. Who signed it?

images.alt: Two brass printing plates, one altered strip highlighted in mint, beside a copper seal.
Two captures show search at version 1.4.2. The description changes from “Search the docs.” to “Search the private docs.” The per-tool and manifest hashes both change.

Publisher CI signs a revision using Sigstore. HISTOR verifies the bundle and Rekor proof at ingest, records the accepted revision, and compares its manifest digest with the client’s raw tools in a separate step.
